subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Skimming and the first tips for faster reading / Vocabulary development and comprehension: new students’ worries
outcomes: Skim a text quickly to choose the best title
Learn words about starting university, such as campus and deadline
Understand new students' worries and how to cope with them

tf.s: This unit aims to improve your reading speed.
tf.why: Yes, the focus is speed reading.

tf.s: When skimming, you should look up every new word in a dictionary.
tf.why: Looking up every word slows you down and stops you reading for gist.

tf.s: Pictures and sub-headings can help you skim a text.
tf.why: Correct, they show you the main ideas quickly.

tf.s: 'Campus' means the grounds and buildings of a university.
tf.why: Right, students live and study on campus.

tf.s: New students in the text feel only bored about starting university.
New students can ask other students, tutors or support services for help.
tf.why: Yes, the text suggests these people.

tf.s: Joining clubs and societies is a way to make friends.
tf.why: Correct, the text gives this advice.

tf.s: A 'deadline' is the time a piece of work must be finished by.
tf.why: Yes, missing a deadline is a common worry.

tf.s: Title a was best because the text is about someone's first year.
tf.why: The text is not about one person's first year; title d is best.

tf.s: 'Homesickness' means feeling ill because your house is dirty.
tf.why: Homesickness is feeling sad because you miss home.

boxes.q: Why shouldn't you look up every word when skimming?
boxes.why: Skimming is about speed and gist.
The campus is where the university is.

boxes.q: Which is a problem new students may face?
boxes.why: A big campus can be confusing.

boxes.q: What does the text suggest for making friends?

boxes.why: Apprehensive means nervous about what will happen.
You do the most important things first.
The text lists people who can help.

boxes.q: Why is title d the best?
o: it covers challenges and how to cope
boxes.why: The best title covers the whole text.

the last word and a dictionary

mcq.q: Which word means 'a feeling of worry or nervousness'?

o: getting lost and forgetting a deadline
losing a phone and a car
mcq.why: These are the examples in the text.

mcq.q: Complete: She missed the ___ for her essay.
mcq.why: A deadline is the last day to hand work in.

o: it covers both the challenges and how to cope with them
it is about a first year

mcq.q: How can a faster reading speed help you at university?
o: it helps with essays, research papers and exams
it means you never need to study
it is only useful for novels
mcq.why: Faster reading saves time in all subjects.

mcq.q: Why might a new student feel both excited and terrified?
o: university brings new freedom but also new worries
there are no new things at university
mcq.why: New independence brings both excitement and worry.
